normalized_separate_basis_not_used_by_q0.note: D07 annual factors are policy assumptions; no FX. Upstream raw_postings_normalized_salary has unknown policy and is never a fallback.

outlier_policy: NO_ADDITIONAL_FILTER candidate; requires explicit approval before official use
precision: Input decimals retained until Spark percentile; scalar output double. No monetary rounding; floating tolerance requires signoff. Not percentile_approx; no approximate rank tolerance.

q07_salary_separate_units.n_min: Distinct jobs in this eligible cell with non-null posted min_salary; max is not required
q07_salary_separate_units.n_max: Distinct jobs in this eligible cell with non-null posted max_salary; min is not required
q07_salary_separate_units.eligible_bundle_n: Distinct D07 USABLE jobs in cell, including med-only
q07_salary_separate_units.population_n: B_g: all supplied population jobs in category/experience before salary/unit/source filters
q07_salary_separate_units.coverage: n_min/B_g, n_max/B_g, eligible_bundle_n/B_g; fractions 0..1; UI percent=100*fraction once
q07_salary_separate_units.iqr: P75-P25 independently for each endpoint; never max_salary-min_salary
q07_salary_separate_units.zero_samples: n=0 gives NULL quantiles and IQR; do not impute. Context with no eligible bundle has summary rows only.
q07_salary_separate_units.small_n: No default threshold; adequate_* NULL without explicit minimum_n. Values retained; suppression requires separate approved policy.

q07_population_summary.note: Includes no-salary groups. This is the authoritative B_g, not SUM of repeated detail denominators.

q07_quality_status.reconciliation: Status counts partition population_n; missing D07 records fail rather than becoming MISSING status. Reason codes overlap and must not be summed as a partition.

official_d07_approval_requirements.identity: approved_by, approved_on, input_sha256 matching salary_clean artifact digest
official_d07_approval_requirements.minimum_salary_group_n: Explicit null or positive integer, equal to input config; no approval supplied by this contract

capabilities.category_experience: Compare existing cells only; NULL context keys join null-safe; NULL is not ALL
capabilities.units: One currency/pay_period/compensation_type and salary_source per comparison
capabilities.all_pooled_multiselect: UNSUPPORTED without recomputation from job-level eligible values; no median-of-medians or summed B_g
capabilities.production: Requires D06 Full validated population, D07 approval bound to input digest and explicit contract v2 decisions. No approval is supplied here.
